content:
Net per cycle = fills − drains = \(200+100-50=250\) L plus Pipe D.

- Cycles 1 and 2: Pipe D adds \(75\) L, so net \(=250+75=325\) L each.
- After 2 cycles: \(2 \times 325 = 650\) L filled.
- Remaining: \(1000-650=350\) L.
- Cycle 3: Pipe D rate increases to \(75+25=100\) L/min, so net \(=250+100=350\) L.

Thus the tank is filled exactly at the end of cycle 3.

Time \(=3 \times 6 = 18\) minutes.

\boxed{18 \text{ minutes}}
